title: lab-notebook SPEC: internal inconsistencies and undocumented behaviour
body:
Found in the spec-vs-code review of branch `worktree-agent-af4147e78b41b3bce` on 2026-11-09. Line numbers are that branch.

- `--fresh` is described under Types but missing from the `nb add` flags in the CLI table.
- `nb set --remove` exists and is tested but is not in the spec.
- Types says `origin` and `user_words` are both required at creation; the rules section and the code require `user_words` only when the origin is `user`.
- Tags are changeable on any node, yet results' fields never change and audits are immutable; the code allows tags.
- The verdict field lists `at` as required; the code makes it optional for older entries.
- Brief: "same variant-of chain" is implemented as the whole connected component, so siblings are included.
- Lineage in code also follows `addresses` and `refines`, which the definition omits.
- The audit bundle carries more than the seven listed items although SPEC says "and nothing else".
- `/nb-audit` says "more recently confirmed" where SPEC says "more recent".
- The skill and auditor file add rules the spec lacks (leads skip scope and alternatives; show the brief as printed).
- Writes refuse only new validation errors; SPEC says nb refuses invalid state.
